description:
About us: BESS Broadway develops grid-scale battery energy storage (BESS) projects in the UK, Europe, Australia, Japan and Latin America. We co-invest with developers in projects at an early or mid stage of development, take them to ready-to-build, and sell them.
Job Description (BESS Broadway):
1. Review routine NDAs, service agreements, and other standard/low-risk contracts against company templates and escalate non-standard terms to legal counsel.
2. Maintain contract trackers and support approval, signature, and filing workflows.
3. Maintain legal files and records, schedule corporate governance meetings, prepare meeting materials, track action items, and handle day-to-day legal administrative tasks such as document circulation, expense/payment requests, and cross-functional coordination.
4. Helping to build our standard documents (term sheets, investment agreements, NDAs, checklists) and the processes our deal team uses.
Key Qualifications and Skills:
1. Must hold a valid visa or other legal authorization to work in Hong Kong.
2. Around 1-2 years' in-house legal, paralegal, or legal administrative experience.
3. Clear, precise written and spoken English. Chinese is a must.
4. Basic contract knowledge, strong attention to detail, confidentiality awareness, and proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and document management systems.
What else to know:
– Three months in China Mainland to work with group team and regularly catch-up with group team going forward.
– Travel. Occasional travel to China mainland or overseas project sites.
